pointer.content: Conflict analysis for SurrealDB authentication fix - 4 conflicts identified (1 HIGH, 1 MEDIUM, 2 LOW), all manageable with coordination

dependencyConflict.issue: Authentication fix expects working SurrealDB client, but official library not installed yet (pip install pending). SurrealDB v2.3.10 needs upgrade to v3.0+ for compatibility.
dependencyConflict.resolution: Install surrealdb-py package and upgrade SurrealDB deployment before authentication testing

architecturalAlignment.issue: Both specs modify cloud_auth.py endpoints. Redis fallback and SurrealDB-first patterns must be aligned.
architecturalAlignment.resolution: Specs are compatible - both treat SurrealDB as primary. Redis fallback correctly implements cache-aside pattern.

performanceSynergy.issue: N+1 query fix from authentication spec shares optimization approach with metrics calculation
performanceSynergy.resolution: Document IN clause pattern as best practice, apply consistently across all multi-record queries

testingCoordination.issue: Both authentication and Thompson sampling specs test activity history, but from different angles
testingCoordination.resolution: Run authentication tests first (UI/display), then Thompson sampling tests (data accuracy). Share Playwright setup.

surrealdb_client_py.recommendation: Complete official library integration first, then apply authentication fixes

cloud_auth_py.recommendation: All changes compatible. Implement: N+1 fix → Redis fallback → impulse metadata

kubernetes_surrealdb_credentials.recommendation: Credentials environment-agnostic. Both specs use same secret.

dashboard_cloud_activity_page.recommendation: Tests validate different aspects. Coordinate execution order.

deploymentCoordination.parallelizationOpportunities: Steps 3, 4, 5 can run in parallel after Steps 1-2 complete
deploymentCoordination.criticalPath: Step 1 must complete before all others - RPC API depends on working SurrealDB client

highRisk: SurrealDB client replacement may have different behavior - maintain legacy backup
mediumRisk: 10-second connection timeout may be too short for slow networks
Increased database load if Redis frequently unavailable
lowRisk: IN clause performance with large org counts - test with 50+ orgs

recommendations.command: pip install surrealdb>=1.0.0 && kubectl set image deployment/surrealdb surrealdb=surrealdb/surrealdb:v3.0 -n metabob
recommendations.reason: Authentication fix depends on working client. Without this, RPC API fails to start.
Both modify cloud_auth.py. Ensure SurrealDB-first pattern respected.

recommendations.action: Share Playwright test setup across specs
recommendations.reason: Avoid duplicating test code for dashboard testing
IN clause pattern should be applied consistently
